name: coursecopilot
description: Your classes inside the AI you already use. Read-only Canvas, course sites, and files — no API key.

canvas_base_url.title: Canvas base URL
canvas_base_url.description: Your school’s Canvas host, e.g. https://umich.instructure.com. Any Canvas instance works.

canvas_token.title: Canvas personal access token
canvas_token.description: Create at Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → + New Access Token. Stored only in this client’s env for the local process — never in the CourseCopilot database, packs, or shared configs. Prefer `coursecopilot canvas connect` so the token lives in ~/.coursecopilot/secrets.json (0600).
